intro.title: Welcome to Arena Duel!
intro.body: Let's get to know the main areas.

character.title: Character
character.body: View your attributes, equipment and Combat Power (CP).

hunt.title: Hunting
hunt.body: Defeat monsters to gain XP and find materials.

huntModal.title: Hunting
huntModal.body: Choose where to hunt. Different areas offer different challenges and resources.

dungeon.title: Dungeon
dungeon.body: Face increasingly difficult floors and receive rewards as you advance.

forge.title: Forge
forge.body: Use materials to create equipment, consumables and processed resources.

final.title: Now it's up to you.
final.body: Explore, test combinations and find your own way to progress.

garden.title: Garden
garden.body: Plant resources that keep growing over time. Come back later to harvest.

mining.title: Mining
mining.body: Extract ores used in recipes and material production.

woodcutting.title: Woodcutting
woodcutting.body: Gather wood used in recipes and processed materials.

deliveries.title: Orders
deliveries.body: Deliver materials in exchange for Gold, XP and other rewards. Materials are consumed when you accept an Order.

reforge.title: Reforge
reforge.body: Trade resources to generate new attributes on a piece of equipment.

sockets.title: Sockets and Gems
sockets.body: Sockets let you insert gems into equipment to modify its attributes.

gear.wooden_club_d: A lump of wood. Better than nothing.
gear.bronze_dagger_d: Short and cheap, but it really cuts.
gear.iron_short_sword_d: Honest iron, well balanced for a new fighter.
gear.steel_greatsword_d: A broad, heavy blade: every swing takes the whole body.
gear.gilded_warblade_d: A war blade with a golden edge, made to find weak spots.
gear.dragon_flameblade_d: Forged with dragon scales: the steel still seems to smolder inside.
gear.voidsteel_blade_d: Voidsteel that leaves a trail of embers where it passes.
gear.abyssal_greatblade_d: An abyssal blade, dark and hot as a live coal.
gear.ragged_clothes_d: Patched rags. They protect you from nothing.
gear.bronze_leather_d: Tanned leather with bronze plates: simple cover for the first floors.
gear.iron_chainmail_d: Iron links that dent under a blow but do not tear.
gear.steel_plate_d: Full steel plate, so firm it throws part of the blow back at the attacker.
gear.gilded_aegis_d: A gilded aegis: far too pretty to be this well armored.
gear.dragon_scale_armor_d: Dragon scales stitched one by one. Warm to the touch, hard as stone.
gear.voidsteel_plate_d: Voidsteel plate, cold and quiet as a starless night.
gear.abyssal_bulwark_d: An abyssal bulwark: whoever wears it seems to carry a wall.
gear.ring_vitality_d: A ring of warm light: wounds close a little at a time while the fight goes on.
gear.amulet_swiftness_d: A light amulet that quickens every swing of the arm.
gear.berserker_crest_d: A crest of fury: critical hits become far more violent.
gear.bronze_helm_d: A plain helm hammered out at the village forge.
gear.iron_helm_d: Heavy and steady. It takes the first blow for you.
gear.steel_helm_d: Well-tempered steel with a reinforced visor.
gear.gilded_helm_d: It shines so bright that enemies hesitate before striking.
gear.voidsteel_helm_d: Forged from a metal that reflects no light at all.
gear.abyssal_helm_d: Black horns and a constant whisper inside the helm.
gear.leather_gloves_d: Soft and plain, good for gripping anything.
gear.iron_gauntlets_d: Every punch lands like a hammer blow.
gear.gilded_gauntlets_d: A champion's finery that also breaks bones.
gear.voidsteel_gauntlets_d: Your fingers seem to vanish inside them.
gear.abyssal_gauntlets_d: Obsidian claws that feel the enemy's pulse.
gear.leather_boots_d: Soles worn from the long walk to the dungeon.
gear.iron_greaves_d: They guard your shins and steady your step.
gear.steel_greaves_d: Light enough to run in, hard enough to hold the line.
gear.gilded_greaves_d: Every step rings like a pocket of coins.
gear.abyssal_greaves_d: The ground seems to give way a little less beneath them.
gear.copper_ring_d: It tints your finger green, but it brings luck.
gear.silver_ring_d: Thin and cold, it glints at the slightest move.
gear.gold_ring_d: Heavy, with an eye engraved on the band.
gear.ruby_ring_d: The stone pulses like a tiny heart.
gear.obsidian_ring_d: Volcanic glass, sharp even on the inside edge.
gear.abyssal_ring_d: A circle of darkness that fits on one finger.
gear.demon_fang_dagger_d: Torn from a Glade demon. It still bites.
gear.demonhide_vest_d: Tanned demon leather: warm to the touch, hard as a hoof.
gear.bloodvein_plate_d: Red veins run through the metal and throb in battle.
gear.riftwalker_boots_d: Whoever wears them never steps twice in the same place.
gear.shadow_hood_d: It bends the light around the wearer's face.
gear.abyss_heart_ring_d: It beats slowly, in time with something far larger.
gear.bonecrusher_maul_d: Too heavy to be elegant, too accurate to be ignored.
gear.goblin_king_crown_d: Small, crooked and studded with stolen gold teeth.
gear.warchief_gauntlets_d: Scored with a name for every battlefield.
gear.lich_soul_ring_d: It holds a soul that does not want to leave.
gear.overlord_greataxe_d: They say the last king of the dungeon swung it one-handed.
